subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface remain read-only, or should it also expose approval resolution authority?
rationale: Listing can reuse an existing scoped RPC, but the active implementation also submits decisions and has unresolved requester-visibility and authority semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Land read-only listing first
options.body: Expose pending/list through the trusted approval-runtime authority with table and JSON output, deferring resolve/respond and watch.

options.title: Adopt full management CLI
options.body: Approve list and resolve/respond together after defining requester-bound visibility and collecting a live list-and-resolve gateway proof.

options.title: Keep decisions interactive
options.body: Allow CLI inspection but retain Control UI or chat surfaces as the only approval-decision paths.

recommendation.title: Land read-only listing first
recommendation.body: Expose pending/list through the trusted approval-runtime authority with table and JSON output, deferring resolve/respond and watch.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the broader durable-approvals direction and has already provided issue-level product routing for this surface.
